H.procedure: Original C_E_Qsize with the original full-region four-scale PCA completion.

fixed_pca.procedure: Fixed Qwen dimensions, same fit-side node/terrain and same camera-slab center calculation as pose_ray, choose the PCA yaw.

pose_ray.procedure: Compute separate camera-slab centers for PCA and frozen Qwen yaw using fixed Qwen dimensions and the same fit-side node. Select the lower optical-depth residual on independent selection returns.

partition.fit_selection_audit: Existing reserve() hash gives fit/selection/audit; the last two are excluded at source draw from fit tree and ground. Attach z-buffered returns inside original window by existing transfer to fit node.

selection.cap: max(0.10 metres, half the smaller horizontal Qwen extent)
selection.loss: Mean of capped absolute first camera-origin slab optical-depth residual divided by cap; miss costs 1.
selection.missing_fit: Keep original Qwen ray-depth (median) fallback; missing 3D decode may have no box and counts as zero.
selection.insufficient_selection: Matched fixed PCA if fitted candidates exist.

scope_rule: Only Ordinary recordings absent from previous evaluation, source fit, calibration, and development rosters. Split by recording identity and retain all its selected physical frames and failures. Seal identity/inputs and predictions before fresh task GT. Record platform coverage and do not reuse the exposed 416 as confirmation.
reporting: Strict oriented IoU > 0.25 and > 0.50; mIoU; all paired rescues and harms against both H and fixed PCA; recording paired bootstrap within platform; all fallbacks and platform counts.
